notes: Closed-loop successor used by V7 Classic, Nevada 750, Breva 750, later California and V11 CAT applications. GuzziDiag/IAWDiag changelogs establish that lambda data, signed trims, CO trim under limited conditions, and model-specific TPS handling exist, but do not publish request bytes, initialization, response widths, or scaling. The former generic KWP identification and routine guesses have been withdrawn: physical use and every diagnostic capability are blocked.

kline.note: K-Line hardware is established by compatible tooling, but baud rate, initialization, addressing, and application framing are not claimed without a family-specific public definition or capture.

session.physical_blocked_reason: Available compatibility records and closed binaries do not disclose a trustworthy family-specific diagnostic initialization or request definition.

memory.write_blocked_reason: A dedicated GuzziDiag-family reader/writer proves that a path exists, but no public source or raw family-specific transfer capture establishes the session, geometry, SecurityAccess, or block sequence.

sources: GuzziDiag / IAWDiag changelogs and feature list (von-der-salierburg.de)
Guzzitek ECU master list and La Guzzitheque injection bible (guzzitek.org)
